title: satk.util.audioFileSm~
description: `satk.util.audioFileSm~` is a flexible audio-file player that can also load raw data files for data mangling or sonification. It supports playback start and end points in milliseconds, looping, normalization, and a de-click envelope; send a bang to play the loaded file, with playback speed set from 0.1 to 500 where 100 is normal, lower values are faster, and higher values are slower.
